Entry.JapaneseText: いたずら魔女？
Entry.Notes: Info on how to unlock each title for https://aselia.fandom.com/wiki/ToP:NDX_-_Arche_Klein:_Titles

Entry.JapaneseText: ささいないたずらが大好きな娘。みんなの驚く顔を 見るとワクワクしちゃう∀ でも、ほんとは……
Entry.EnglishText: A girl who loves to cause mischief. She seems to love seeing the surprised faces of those she pranks, but in truth...

Entry.JapaneseText: マジックユーザー
マナを紡いで、魔法を使えるのはエルフ一族の特権。 でも怠けてたら、覚えた魔法も全部忘れちゃうぞ！
Entry.EnglishText: Weaving mana and wielding magic is a privilege of those born to elves. But if you slack off, you'll forget every spell you've learned!

Entry.JapaneseText: ウイッチ
レベル１２、彼女の詠唱の呼び声に応えて、自然が さざめく。その力はいつも彼女のそばにひそんでいる
Entry.EnglishText: At level 12, nature stirs in response to her incantations. That power has always lain hidden within her.

Entry.JapaneseText: メイジ
レベル３０、奔放な指先で魔法を自在に操る。 超ピンチな仲間の苦境も、一発逆転で覆す力を発揮
Entry.EnglishText: At level 30, she is able to wield magic dexterously and freely. Even the most desperate situations can be reversed with a single spell.

Entry.JapaneseText: ソーサラー
レベル５０、吐息は嵐に、水遊びは津波になり、 叫びは大地を裂く。大魔術師を名乗ってもいい頃
Entry.EnglishText: At level 50, her breath summons a storm, her splash conjures a tsunami, her roar splits the earth. It's time to call her a Grand Mage.

Entry.JapaneseText: ウィザード
レベル８０、この世の真理に後一歩と迫る勢い。 神か、悪魔か、窮極の魔術師の未来はどっち？
Entry.EnglishText: At level 80, she's on the verge of grasping the truth behind the world. As the ultimate mage, will she choose the path of a goddess or demon?

Entry.JapaneseText: スペルマスター
出し惜しみなんてナシよ∀ 自分の知恵は全部、 優秀な弟子に譲っちゃう♪ しっかり成長してね
Entry.EnglishText: I ain't gonna hold back, y'hear! I'll pass on all my wisdom to my talented disciples♪ Grow strong, 'kay?

Entry.JapaneseText: ゆめみるおとめ
はずかしい夢を見て思わず寝言でつぶやいたのは、 本人も知らない。誰かさんだけが聞いていた
Entry.EnglishText: She was totally unaware of what she had muttered in her sleep during her embarassing dream. It's a shame someone overheard her.

Entry.JapaneseText: ぺったんこ
「あたし、まだまだ成長期！」とは本人の談。 ２００歳を越えて成長期も何もあったもんじゃない
Entry.EnglishText: "I'm still growing!" or so she claims. But at the ripe old age of 200, there's no way she'll be getting a growth spurt.

Entry.JapaneseText: グルメマスター？
全料理をマスター
わたしブライトローズ
Entry.Notes: Sub-Event: 54: Itazura Musume Big Eye must be defeated -Talk to the woman near the entrance of [AC. 4408] Olive Village with Arche in the party

Entry.JapaneseText: 明るい薔薇色の服着た魔女。すっかり大悪人に されているけれど、本当はみんなに愛されてる
Entry.EnglishText: A witch who dresses in bright rose colored robes. Though she was cast as the villain, everyone actually loves her.

Entry.JapaneseText: ＧＲＯＯＶＹ
ちょいとお出かけ、グルグルグルーヴィー♪ 暴れホウキも乗りこなす、名ライダーっぷりは必見！
Entry.EnglishText: Headin' out fur a spin, groovy-roovy-groove♪ Check out the legendary rider who can handle the wildest broomsticks. She's a sight to behold!
